```{r setup, include=FALSE}
source(here::here("scripts/R/functions/report_setup.R"))
setup_report(
  funs = c("dag_helpers"),
  packages = c("here", "ggplot2", "dplyr", "dagitty", "ggdag"),
  set_theme = FALSE
)
```

```{r dag-sens-plot, fig.width=9, fig.height=7}
#| fig-cap: "Sensitivity DAG for the METIMMOX-1 analysis, excluding the Age -> TMB_BRAF and Sex -> TMB_BRAF edges while retaining all other assumed causal relationships. Solid arrows denote assumed causal effects; dashed arrows indicate the hypothesised interaction effects of T x TMB/BRAF and T x CRP on PFS and OS."

p <- plot_full_dag(dag_sens)
print(p)
```

```{r save-figure, include=FALSE}
figs_dir <- here("figs")
if (!dir.exists(figs_dir)) dir.create(figs_dir, recursive = TRUE)

ggsave(
  filename = here("figs", "clin_effect_figure_sensitivity_dag.png"),
  plot = p,
  width = 9, height = 7, dpi = 300, bg = "white"
)
cat("Figure saved to:", here("figs", "clin_effect_figure_sensitivity_dag.png"), "\n")
```

Figure saved to `figs/clin_effect_figure_sensitivity_dag.png`.
